message.content: {"count":4,"rationale":"Block appServer:lateralMovement, serviceAccount:privilegeEscalation, jumpHost:lateralMovement, and printServer:lateralMovement. This also makes hypervisor, localAdmin, and secretsManager unreachable, so none of the target’s four parents is reachable. Three blocks cannot suffice: if appServer remains reachable, vaultRead, codeRepo, and dbReplica must all be blocked, leaving shareMount reachable. Making appServer unreachable without blocking it requires at least three blocks across memoryDump, apiToken’s dependencies, and ssoLogin’s dependencies, leaving jumpHost reachable through dbLogin. Thus any solution with at most three blocks must block appServer itself. Of the two remaining blocks, one must block printServer or dbReplica; otherwise stopping printServer requires both memoryDump and iotDevice, leaving jumpHost and shareMount reachable. The final single block cannot stop both the remaining serviceAccount-to-codeRepo route and jumpHost-to-shareMount route. Therefore four is minimal."}
